nav.title: Xarunta Xiriirka AI
nav.subtitle: Adeeg iskaa wax u qabso luqadada kala duwan oo leh gudbin la maamulo.

status.apiUnavailable: Gelitaan / API aan la heli karin

stats.uniqueCodesNote: Kuwa soo noqda waxaa lagu calaamadeeyaa
stats.providerQualificationNote: Luqadaha tijaabiyay madaxbannaan kaliya ayaa la tiriyaa

customer.title: Bilow wadahadal
customer.consentText: Waxaan ogolaanayaa in wadahadlankan laga shaqeeyo bixiyaha AI la habay. Dhammaan qoraallada waa la sirceed iyo kaynta ka hor.
customer.startChat: Bilow wada sheekaysig qoraal ah oo ammaan ah
customer.setupHint: Lama heli karo ilaa maamuluhu uu dulsaaro furaha sirreeynta iyo bixiyaha AI.
customer.startHint: Si aad u bilowdo, samee kalfadhi aqbal.
customer.requestHuman: Codso wakiil ka mid ah bini'aadamka
customer.chatEmpty: Fariimaheenna waxay halkan ka muuqan doonaan. Falalka AI waa kaliya talooyin; lacag bixin, bedelka akoonaha, jiritaanka ama diritaan ma dhaqaajisaan.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Codka biraawsarka waxaa loo gudbiyaa si joogto ah bixiyaha la habeeyay; OpsCore ma sheegto inuu kaydiyo codka ceyriinka ah.
customer.voiceRequirement: Codka biraawsarku wuxuu u baahan yahay HTTPS (ama localhost), makarafoon, oggolaansho, moodel Realtime la habeeyay iyo furaha bixiyaha. Ma aha buundo telefoon oo PSTN/SIP ah.

queue.title: Safka korriyada
queue.description: Wadahadallada khatarta weyn, aan la xallin ama la codsaday bini'aadam ayaa halkan ka muuqda. Shayga safku waa codsaday, aan la xiriirin.
queue.empty: Ma jiro gudbin bini'aadam oo firfircoon ururkaan.
queue.replyStorageNote: Jawaabaha bini'aadamka waa la sirayaa marka la kaydinayo oo waxay ka muuqdaan qoraalka wada hadalka.
queue.resolveNote: Waxaa xaliyay hawlwade bini'aadam ah oo loo igmaday.

boundaries.title: Xuduudka hawlgallada
boundaries.automateBody: Jawaabta ugu horreysa oo luqadada kala duwan, cadeyn, kala soocida ujeeddada iyo khatarta, kaydinta ammaan ah ee qoraallada, samaynta safaf iyo dhisidda wakiillada.
boundaries.humanTitle: Waxaa loo baahan yahay in qof bini'aadam wareego
boundaries.humanBody: Codsasho bini'aadam oo caddaan, kalsooni hooseeya, khatarta weyn ama xasaasiya, siyaasad la'aan, xaalad aan la xallin, cabasho gaar/amaantiin ama ficil aan hubayn.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Hagida PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/email, taageerada taleefanka tooska ah, xaqiijinta aqoonsiga CRM iyo sheegashada tayada luqadda waxay u baahan yihiin tuugga xiriirka bixiyaha, xogta gelitaanka iyo tijaabooyin aqbal.

handoffReasons.model_requested: AI wuu codsaday dib u eegis
handoffReasons.voice_review_required: Dib u eegis cod loo baahan yahay

messages.qualificationNotice: Luqadna ma kuwa soo dhisay tan iyo ay ka gudbaan tijaabooyin qoraalka, ASR, TTS, naxweynta iyo korriyada.
messages.configOk: Habaynta jirta. Xiriirka bixiyaha iyo tayada luqadda wali waxay u baahan yihiin tijaabooyin dhab ahaan.
messages.conversationCreated: Wadahadal ammaan ah la sameeyay. Tayada luqadda weli ma kuwa soo dhisay.
messages.handoffQueued: Gudbinta bini'aadamka waxaa lagu daray safka ({reason}). Kani waa codsi safka, aan xiriir toos ah ahayn.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Jawaabta AI ma dhammaystirin. Ficil lama fulin. Waad codsan kartaa wakiil bini'aadam.
messages.apiUnavailable: API-ga Xarunta Xiriirka lama soo rari karin. Gal console-ka OpsCore, kadibna dib u soo rar bogga.
messages.suggestedNextStep: Tallaabada xigta ee la soo jeediyay kaliya (lama fulin): {step}.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Wareejinta qof bini'aadam ah waxaa lagu daray safka ({reason}). Safku ma caddeeyo in wakiil xiran yahay.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Wareejinta qof bini'aadam ah waxaa lagu daray safka. Fadhiga AI ee biraawsarka waa istaagayaa; wareejinta telefoonka tooska ah lama habayn.
messages.voiceCredentialRequest: Waxaa la codsanayaa aqoonsi codeed muddo gaaban ah…
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Bixiyaha waqtiga dhabta ah ayaa soo sheegay khalad. Jooji fadhiga codka oo isku day mar kale kadib marka aad hubiso habaynta bixiyaha.
messages.voiceActive: Fadhiga codka waa shaqaynayaa. Wakhti kasta taabo “Codso wakiil ka mid ah bini'aadamka”; tani waxay abuurtaa shay safka ku jira, ma aha wareejin PSTN ah.
messages.voiceCredentialActive: {languageCode} · aqoonsi ku meel gaar ah oo bixiyaha

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_CONSENT_REQUIRED: Oggolaansho ayaa loo baahan yahay ka hor intaan wada hadalku bilaaban.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Bixiyaha codka waqtiga dhabta ah lama gaari karin.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Biraawsarkani ma taageero codka waqtiga dhabta ah.
errors.CONTACT_CENTER_DUPLICATE_MESSAGE: Fariinta nuqul-ka-dhigan waa la iska indho tiray.
